summary_1line: Victor returns to Geneva, agrees to marry Elizabeth despite the monster’s threat, and sails with her to Evian on their wedding night under ominous foreboding.

image_candidates.scene_text: Victor sits pale and tormented while confessing to his bewildered father that he is the murderer of William, Justine, and Henry.
Victor and Elizabeth sail across Lake Geneva beneath the setting sun, Mont Blanc glowing in the distance as an uneasy silence hangs between them.
At sunset Victor steps onto the shore at Evian beside Elizabeth, his face darkened by dread as he remembers the monster’s promise to come on his wedding night.
